capability_declaration.evidence: Clause 5.3 (DER capabilities), Clause 10 (Interoperability and communication), Table 1 (Mandatory DER capabilities), Clause 6.4.2 (Voltage-reactive power modes), Clause 7.3.2 (Frequency-watt droop parameters), Clause 5.7 (Capability categories A & B).
capability_declaration.rationale: IEEE 1547 explicitly requires DERs to declare operational capabilities upon commissioning and nameplate data with extensive parameterization tables.

bounded_authority.evidence: Clause 5.8 (DER settings), Clause 8 (Islanding), Clause 10.3 (Authorization to operate), Clause 6.5 (Voltage ride-through curves).
bounded_authority.rationale: Settings boundaries exist but authority is human/operator-centric; no clause defines autonomous agent scope, revocation logic, or dynamic delegation.

decision_auditability.rationale: No clauses address logging, attribution, or traceability of autonomous decisions. Monitoring requirements in Clause 10 are about operational states, not decision records.

data_governance.rationale: IEEE 1547 is silent on data ownership, consent, retention, or privacy. Communication protocols are scoped but governance of the data itself is not addressed.
